package.name: reachability_moveit
package.description: Stand verification for the reachability planner: confirms RM4D stands with inverse kinematics and collision checking through the motion_planner IkPort / CollisionPort / ScenePort (MoveIt today, any backend that implements the ports). PortStandVerifier is ROS-free; stand_verify_probe measures RM4D-versus-IK agreement against a running MoveIt demo.
